text: Implement abc to αβ0 transform, 3 inputs, 3 outputs; {Power Invariant} enables power invariance, {Use block for embedded implementation (requires Motor Control Blockset™)} sets the option to use block for embedded and {Number of inputs} sets the number of block. Values come from the instance.
